linearity: One call per document with no tool use, no retrieval loop and no multi-turn control flow, so call count is exactly the document count and the input bill is the sum of document lengths. The distribution is what matters for a projection: the mean document is several times the median, so a corpus with a different length profile scales by total tokens and not by document count.
